name: Anderson Ferguson
bio: A Representative from Georgia; born in Lansdale, Houston County, Ala., November 15, 1966; graduated from Springwood School, Lanett, Ala., 1985; attended University of Georgia, Athens, Ga., 1988; D.M.D., Medical College of Georgia, Augusta, Ga., 1992; dentist; member of the West Point, Ga., board of aldermen, 1997-1999; Mayor of West Point, Ga., 2008-2016; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Fifteenth and to the three succeeding Congresses (January 3, 2017-Janaury 3, 2025); was not a candidate for reelection to the One Hundred Nineteenth Congress in 2024.
